subject.title: build(deps): bump github.com/steipete/commander from 0.2.2 to 0.2.3 in /apps/swabble in the swift-deps group across 1 directory

question: Should Commander 0.2.3 be sponsored now as an atomic macOS SwiftPM graph update, or should this isolated Dependabot bump wait until the rest of the graph is ready?
rationale: The desired dependency version is a release-policy choice, while the current one-file patch cannot safely resolve the shared exact-version graph by itself.

options.title: Sponsor atomic graph update
options.body: Align all Commander requirements and resolved pins in one change and require a green macOS Swift build plus focused Swabble CLI behavior proof.

options.title: Wait for graph alignment
options.body: Keep or close this isolated bump without merging until the other Swift package constraints are ready to move to 0.2.3 together.

recommendation.title: Sponsor atomic graph update
